title: Rogue Street TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Bell Rogue Street TC-2 delivers stripped-down minimalist coverage for relaxed warm-weather cruising, pairing low-profile styling with essential certified head protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1434g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~99 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Unique half-helmet with detachable muzzle for aggressive styling.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Fits most head shapes; slightly roomy for larger heads due to TC-2 specific sizing.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Rogue Street TC-2: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Half lineup, the Rogue Street TC-2 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Bell Rogue Street TC-2 represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Half helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Rogue Street TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
